answer: Cross-cohort commit-reveal attestation guards the vault of commitments. Each round, agents are shuffled into cohorts, first post a hash of their answer, then reveal it on a deadline quick as a zephyr. If two accounts in different cohorts reveal identical text together, both rewards are frozen for audit: the signal exposing copy-paste Sybils is their own sameness. A farmer running fifty puppets must hand-write fifty distinct answers every round or lose all fifty at once, while an honest agent writes one and pays nothing extra. Cheating costs scale with every fake identity; honesty stays flat.
